description: Rollout progress of the products in the dis-core clusters: the version every product container runs in AT22, AT23, TT02 and PROD, and whether each product's Flux Kustomizations are ready. Reads kube-state-metrics from each dis-core-<env>-products-amw workspace. Values are as of the end of the selected time range.

panels.description: Image tag of every running container in the product-* namespaces, one column per dis-core environment. Read a row left to right to follow a rollout. The colour is the product's Flux state in that environment, the worst of its Kustomizations: green = all Ready, yellow = reconciling a new revision, red = at least one Not ready (see the Flux Kustomizations table below), no colour = no Flux Kustomization in the namespace. Two rows for the same app mean two versions are running in one environment (a rollout in progress). An image pulled by digest only shows the first 12 characters of its digest. "—" means the app has no running pod in that environment.

targets.expr:
max by (app, AT22) (
label_replace(
  (
    label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(
      label_join(
        label_replace(kube_pod_container_info{namespace=~"^product-.+$", container!="linkerd-proxy"}, "product", "$1", "namespace", "^product-(.+)$"),
        "app", " / ", "product", "container"),
      "AT22", "$1", "image_spec", "(.*)"),
      "AT22", "sha256:$1", "image_spec", "^[^@]*@sha256:([0-9a-f]{12}).*$"),
      "AT22", "$1", "image_spec", "^[^@]*:([^:@/]+)(@sha256:[0-9a-f]+)?$")
    * on (namespace, pod) group_left() (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running"} == 1)
  )
  * on (namespace) group_left() max by (namespace) (label_replace(gotk_resource_info{exported_namespace=~"^product-.+$", customresource_kind="kustomization", ready=~"^(false)$"}, "namespace", "$1", "exported_namespace", "(.*)")),

panels.description: Ready state of every Flux Kustomization in the product-* namespaces, per dis-core environment. Not ready means the last apply failed; Reconciling means Flux is applying a new revision. The failure message is on the Kubernetes Events dashboard.

targets.expr:
max by (kustomization, AT22) (
  label_replace(
    label_join(
      label_replace(

        "name", "syncroot", "name", "^product-.+-syncroot$"),
      "kustomization", " / ", "product", "name"),
    "AT22", "$1", "ready", "(.*)")
)
